questions.question: What is ‘bank rate’?
options: Interest rate charged by commercial banks from customers
Rate at which RBI lends money to commercial banks without any security

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Rate at which RBI lends money to commercial banks without any security) है।
